adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/CalendarManager.ts, the new `externalId?` argument to `createEvent` is never used to influence which calendar the provider writes to; it’s only echoed back in the returned `EventResult` (`externalId, credentialId: credential.id`). Meanwhile, GoogleCalendarService.createEvent selects the calendar purely via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and otherwise falls back to `"primary"` (`calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`). Therefore it is possible for `EventManager` to record `result.externalId` (from the pass-through) that does not match the calendar actually used by the integration (e.g., when the find misses and Google uses `primary`, or when multiple destination calendars share a credentialId and `.find` returns the first one). This is a correctness issue because stored `externalCalendarId` can be wrong.
